thread:
dina: Quick note from the shadow of v7-int4: overall cohort looks stable but the long-doc slice shows a repeatable MRR drop (~5%). We need an anchored canary rule before any traffic split. :warning:

 rafa: Numbers? sample sizes and CI?

 dina: control 7.4k, variant 1.9k. long-doc MRR control 0.398 -> variant 0.378 (rel -5.0%). bootstrap 95% lower = -0.042.

 yuki: Sounds like KV-merge corruption or prompt truncation in long contexts. Top pairs show suffix clipping in ~30% of worst regressions.

 rafa: Proposal: CI-driven gate + per-slice minima + ensemble confirm. Minimal policy sketch:
  - global_min_samples: 1000
  - per_slice_min: long-doc 500
  - comparator: bootstrap 95% lower bound
  - abort_threshold: -0.03 rel on mrr
  - sustained: 3 windows (window=1800s), cap windows=4
  - ensemble: require 2 metrics (mrr + accept_rate) to auto-rollback
  - entropy_proxy: if entropy drops >20% AND mrr down >2% -> immediate hold

 yuki: Also add per-slice auto_rollback_allowed flag (long-doc true, micro-slices false) and hysteresis: suppress rollback if variant recovers within 2 windows.

 dina: Good. Action items: dina upload top-200 pairs to artifacts, yuki run token-diff and annotate truncation cases, rafa wire Optimize /eval/bootstrap into canary-checker, ops-bot run a dry-canary tomorrow 07:00 UTC and post artifacts.

 ops-bot: [system] Dry-canary scheduled at 2024-03-15T07:00:00Z. Artifacts path: /artifacts/canary/3192000000/. Policy draft "longdoc-anchor-v1" created.

 rafa: Lock promotion until the anchor rule and smoke paired-run pass.

 dina: Agreed. Thanks all. :lock:
